description: Run the bounded HPCC RandomAccess 64-bit table read-modify-write kernel and return a deterministic final-table digest.

source.title: HPC Challenge RandomAccess Rules
source.algorithm_attribution: The sequential update recurrence is ran=(ran<<1) XOR (top_bit ? 7 : 0), followed by Table[ran & (N-1)] ^= ran.

output.encoding: nonnegative low-63-bit value of the unsigned 64-bit position-weighted table checksum
output.digest: sum((i+1)*T[i]) in unsigned 64-bit arithmetic, followed by clearing bit 63

contract.random_state_step: Inspect bit 63 before the shift; ran=((ran<<1) mod 2^64) XOR 7 when that bit is one, otherwise ran=(ran<<1) mod 2^64.
contract.table_indexing: Use the low log2(N) state bits for this bounded single-process profile.
contract.complexity: O(N) time and O(N) auxiliary storage
contract.scope: Does not implement MPI distribution, process stream partitioning, lookahead, or unlocked update races.
